title: The Junction Where Patience Becomes Current

features.name: water crossing
features.desc-on-touch: Where patient ground finally meets impatient river. The water teaches the road that stillness was just slowness given a longer name.

features.name: patience pool
features.desc-on-touch: The water here moves slowly, still holding the memory of being still. It is learning that motion is patience played at a different speed.

features.name: current marker stone
features.desc-on-touch: A stone mid-river, worn smooth by ten thousand years of argument between the road's patience and the water's speed. Both are winning; both have learned from each other.

features.name: lesson cascade
features.desc-on-touch: The lesson flows now, each word becoming a faster current as it falls. Stone remembers. Water forgets and learns again with every drop.

features.name: threshold plant
features.desc-on-touch: Root and water trading stories. The plant has learned to speak both languages: the slow grammar of soil, the fast syntax of the river.

inscription: the river learned patience from the road, the road learned haste from the river, both became whole

file.name: Junction_Confluence_Recording_Late_Afternoon.mp3
file.note: The sound of teaching at a crossing: water on stone, stone holding. The lesson roars now, but remembers its stillness.

following the roar downstream where the lesson becomes a story
